dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Chris. Is this your first networking event?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, aɪm ˈkrɪs. ɪz ðɪs jʊr ˈfɜːrst ˈnɛtwɜːrkɪŋ ɪˈvɛnt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. I'm Nam. I'm a bit nervous, actually.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪt ˈɪz. aɪm ˈnɑːm. aɪm ə ˈbɪt ˈnɜːrvəs, ˈæktʃuəli.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Are you? You don't look nervous at all.
dialogue.reading: ˈɑːr juː? juː ˈdoʊnt ˈlʊk ˈnɜːrvəs ət ˈɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's good! People say that first impressions are important.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡʊd! ˈpiːpəl ˈseɪ ðæt ˈfɜːrst ɪmˈprɛʃənz ər ɪmˈpɔːrtənt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: They are. I've been to about twenty of these events.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈɑːr. aɪv bɪn tə əˈbaʊt ˈtwɛnti əv ðiːz ɪˈvɛnts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Have you really? You must love socializing!
dialogue.reading: ˈhæv juː ˈriːli? juː mʌst ˈlʌv ˈsoʊʃəlaɪzɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I do. When I moved to Bangkok two years ago, I didn't know anyone.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈduː. wɛn aɪ ˈmuːvd tə ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈtuː ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ, aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈnoʊ ˈɛniwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Didn't you? That must have been hard.
dialogue.reading: ˈdɪdənt juː? ðæt mʌst hæv bɪn ˈhɑːrd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It was. But small talk at events like this helped me make friends.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈwʌz. bʌt ˈsmɔːl ˌtɔːk ət ɪˈvɛnts ˈlaɪk ðɪs ˈhɛlpt miː ˈmeɪk ˈfrɛndz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Did it? Then I need to practice my small talk!
dialogue.reading: ˈdɪd ɪt? ˈðɛn aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈpræktɪs maɪ ˈsmɔːl ˌtɔːk!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You're doing fine. So, what do you do, Nam?
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈduːɪŋ ˈfaɪn. soʊ, ˈwʌt duː juː ˈduː, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm an English teacher. I started my first job last month.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈtiːtʃər. aɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈdʒɑːb ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ.
